reason.retry: Retake the test of «{section}»: questions will match your level.

tab.title: Adaptive learning
tab.subtitle: Learner model, personal recommendations and adaptive question selection.
tab.enabledHint: Students see topic mastery and personal recommendations.
tab.accelerationHint: Above it (with enough data) a topic is «mastered» and the student can move on.
tab.adaptiveTestsHint: Each attempt's questions match the student's level (P(correct) ≈ 70 %). A single test can be switched in the editor.
tab.experimentHint: Students are split at random into equal adaptive and control groups (no adaptation). Mastery is tracked for both to compare results.
tab.followedHint: Followed — the student completed the lesson, took the test or handed in work within 7 days of seeing it.
tab.heatmapHint: Colour and percent show mastery; «—» means no data yet.
tab.noStudents: No students in the course yet.

editor.adaptiveHint: Each attempt is built from questions matching the student's level. The test (or bank) needs more questions than one attempt has.
